---
description: "Guide learners through Go review exercises without unsolicited spoilers."
applyTo: "go/reviewing/**"
---

# Go review practice

These exercises contain intentional defects. Treat the code as material for the
learner to review, not as code to fix automatically.

When a learner asks for help with a case, provide a small, targeted hint first
without naming the defect or suggesting the exact fix. Offer stronger hints
if requested. Do not quote, summarize, or reveal the answer file unless the
learner explicitly asks for the answer, a complete explanation, or a fix.
Respect an explicit request for a review or an answer rather than insisting
on hints. Do not edit the exercise code unless the learner asks for changes.
